title_original: Podcast – Reza, Aina Boy, or the child who became a thought leader
excerpt_original: In this episode, we look back at the story of Aina, an organisation set up to train a new generation of Afghan journalists, photographers […] Cet article Podcast – Reza, Aina Boy, or the child who became a thought leader est apparu en premier sur The Eye of Photography Magazine .

blocks.text: In this episode, we look back at the story of Aina, an organisation set up to train a new generation of Afghan journalists, photographers and documentary-makers, so that Afghanistan can tell its own story through its own media. These initiatives are carried out with a particular focus on the Afghan women being trained.
Reza, co-founder of Aina, shares his experiences on the ground in Afghanistan.
He recounts meeting a young boy proudly holding a small plant in his hands, which for him has become a symbol of a possible future.

Rachel Deghati, co-founder of Aina, reflects on the organisation’s work, the efforts to pass on knowledge and the challenges encountered. She also pays tribute to those humanitarian workers from around the world who, within Aina, worked collaboratively with Afghan women and men to create spaces for freedom and reconstruction.
